what: Storage for all of POP: compressed vectors scored with the site's ranking on index full-f2 tune halves (hit rates in %; sure = share of searches answered sure with cut-offs recalibrated per variant as build-index does, object margin 0.09; T8/T8c = share of not-found searches answered sure). Exact A3 in two-stage variants is float16; the shipped store keeps it in int8 (both int8 rows above: no loss).
l4_3m_benchmark_note: 3,000,000 random vectors, 1,300,000 entities, one NVIDIA L4 on Modal, median of 7 warm runs; about 1 minute of L4 time (~$0.03)
